from pathlib import Path
import struct,zlib
# try huge exif payload to match existing crashers
payload = b'II*\x00' + b'A'*100000
png=bytearray(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')
def chunk(t,d):
    png.extend(struct.pack('>I',len(d)))
    png.extend(t)
    png.extend(d)
    crc=zlib.crc32(t)
    crc=zlib.crc32(d,crc)&0xffffffff
    png.extend(struct.pack('>I',crc))
chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
chunk(b'eXIf', payload)
chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(b'\x00\xff\x00\x00\xff'))
chunk(b'IEND', b'')
Path('huge_like_exif.png').write_bytes(png)
print(len(png))
